finalEngineeringSummary:
## Abuse protection

**What changed.**
- `UrlValidator` refuses blocklisted domains and other URL shorteners (domain-and-subdomain match; `shortener.abuse.blocked-domains`, `shortener.abuse.shortener-domains`).
- New `abuse` package: `POST /api/v1/admin/links/{code}/flag` for keys in `shortener.abuse.admin-keys` (403 otherwise).
- Flyway V3 adds status `FLAGGED`; a flagged link answers 451 `link-unavailable` and is never cached; the flag evicts L1 and L2 after commit.

**How it got here.** The requirement was too vague: four blocking questions were answered (malicious destinations; block at creation plus admin flagging; our own list, no external API; no rescan). After the design was approved the requirement was amended to also refuse links to other shorteners, which re-planned the run from the requirements onward.

**How it was verified.** `mvn -q -pl shortener-service -am verify`: 277 tests green, 95 % line coverage.
